text:
The prepositions in the text and their roles are:

1. **on** (in "live on") - Connects the verb "live" to the object "the planet".
2. **Among** (in "Among the crowd") - Connects the noun phrase "a young artist" to the location "the crowd".
3. **for** (in "searched for") - Connects the verb "searched" to the object "inspiration".
4. **from** (in "from face") - Connects the verb "moving" to the starting point "face".
5. **to** (in "to face") - Connects the preposition "from" to the second object "face", forming the phrase "from face to face".
6. **in** (in "in the hustle") - Connects the adverb "here" to the location "the hustle and bustle".
7. **of** (in "of the city") - Connects the noun phrase "the hustle and bustle" to the specific location "the city".
8. **for** (in "for her next creation") - Connects the noun "spark" to its purpose or target "her next creation".
